2534-3817-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.
2534-3817-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

225-3129-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-3129-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

907-1479-7885.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

4644-7066-7791.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Avatar Kyoshi.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7510.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3967-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3259-4053-6968-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-6968-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-6968-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

2681-5881-5885-7014.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2681-5881-5885-7014.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
2681-5881-5885-7014.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Maulfist Squad ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

141-3269-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3269-5231.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3269-5231.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

339-677-955-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1115-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1567-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Momentary Blink.
813-1567-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2583-3334-5870-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
2583-3334-5870-5902.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1846-2026-4222.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
1846-2026-4222.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat from step 2

222-527-1322-2438.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1322-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

710-997-4775.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

372-3378-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-4125.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2511-2757-3327.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2511-2757-3327.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2608-4499-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1621-3455.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces.
1621-3455.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vizier of Many Faces. Choose to have Vizier of Many Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2732-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kiki-Jiki's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the token Prowling Geistcatcher's power.
Repeat.

488-3518-4499.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and disacrding your hand, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Loran.
When Loran enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2292-4763-4766.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

628-1242-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

236-1978-2364.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Bring to Life.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.
